snippet.title: Waveling Island - Official Reveal Trailer | ID@Xbox Fall 2026
snippet.description:
Don't miss the Reveal Trailer for Waveling Island, a cozy creature-collecting game developed by Berserker Boy Games. Players will explore a hand-drawn pixel-art island packed full of mysterious creatures called Wavelings. Craft, battle, make friends, explore, and uncover the island's secrets. Waveling Island is coming soon to Xbox Series X|S and PC.

#IGN #Gaming #Xbox
